clips.title: The story
paras: At Ironclad Cove, Mr. Smite keeps watch over the Defias ship and its crew. The tauren serves Captain Greenskin as first mate, guarding the docks where Edwin VanCleef's dreadnaught is being fitted out. Any intruder who meets him faces a changing array of weapons and formidable strength.

Mr. Smite keeps order on the docks of Ironclad Cove as first mate to the goblin Captain Greenskin. The Defias Brotherhood is made up mostly of disaffected humans and goblin tinkerers, yet Smite is a battle-hardened tauren far from Kalimdor's plains. He has charge of a rowdy pirate crew while they fit out Edwin VanCleef's secret dreadnaught, and he allows no disruption to the work.

Mr. Smite fights with more than brute force; he is a showman and a versatile weaponmaster. He toys with challengers, drawing out the fight and offering them a false hope of victory. When pressed, he stamps the ground with such force that foes are stunned, then searches a nearby chest for another weapon. He begins with a quick dueling blade, moves to twin cleaving reavers, and brings out a huge two-handed warhammer when pushed far enough.
